title: First flight of the A-12, 30 April 1962 (CIA OXCART history, p. 290)
description: Boxed, high-contrast photograph of the A-12 in flight in side profile, its dark fuselage set against a pale speckled sky. The caption reads "First flight of the A-12, 30 April 1962." Text below covers development of the J58 engine and the section "SPEED-RELATED PROBLEMS" on inlet shock-wave difficulties between Mach 2.4 and 2.8.
